subject: Confirmation of Hotel Reservation
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are pleased to confirm your reservation at the Oceanfront Hotel for the dates of July 15th to July 20th. Your deluxe room with a sea view has been reserved as requested. Please note that the total cost of your stay, including taxes and fees, is $800. We kindly ask that you provide a valid credit card to secure the booking. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our reservations team. We look forward to welcoming you to our hotel!
